svg.title: Asimov v1 platform architecture
svg.desc: Architecture diagram. Tele-operation stack and locomotion policy (Raspberry Pi 5 · no Performance Level claim): WebRTC video and operator link, Asimov API (pre-1.0), Learned locomotion policy, unreleased, Authenticated, bounded commands, Rate and range limits before the bus, Pinned builds, signed updates. Deterministic safety layer on the motion control board (Radxa CM5 · PL d target for the clamps, the watchdog and the controlled descent): Joint torque and velocity clamps (SF-03), IMU plausibility and cross-check (SF-23), Scheduler watchdog and deadline monitor (SF-24), Controlled descent on fault (SF-02), Mode machine DAMP · STAND · MOVE, Software joint limits inside the end-stops (SF-25). Safety-related control system (PL d target · ISO 13849-1 · nothing in software can hold a contactor closed): Dual-channel wired E-stop pendant, Safety relay with monitored reset, Actuator-rail contactors, E-stop link surveillance (SF-13), Fuse table and disconnect, Tether and gantry in the laboratory. A cross-cutting safety and assurance column of draft work products applies to every layer: Item definition and risk assessment, Safety functions and required PL, SRP/CS architecture and PL calculation, Fall, descent, contact and E-stop validation, Cybersecurity threat assessment, Safety case and technical file, Decision register and gates. Legend: Inherited, functional only; Hardened by the fork (proposed); To be built, PL d target; Proposed, not yet in any repository.
